calls.title: Scott McAllister and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the importance of developer advocacy in bridging technical expertise with user education, particularly in areas like data science and experimentation. Scott McAllister emphasized the need for demo-driven education that showcases solutions over sales, while Ashley Stirrup pointed out gaps in advocacy coverage for data scientists. The collaboration with subject matter experts is crucial for turning complex content into digestible product applications. Challenges such as engagement during interactive sessions were discussed, along with the role of podcasts in building genuine community dialogues. Overall, the advocacy role is framed as essential for translating intricate product features into practical guidance, aligning technical skills with user needs.
calls.keywords: Developer Advocacy, Data Science, A/B Testing, Terraform, Podcasting, Incident Response Automation
